csv_project_name: On Call Professional Engrg Architectural & Related Svc
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Farmington is using this RFQP to award contracts to multiple professional service firms by requesting qualifications-based proposals (RFQPs) from an engineering firm, architectural firm or related professional service firms that can adequately demonstrate their ability to provide a variety of services on an as-needed basis. The services may include but are not limited to engineering, architectural, landscaping, civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, controls, or other related services as determined by the City. Other services may also include parks, recreation design, pedestrian/bicycle facilities, water/wastewater infrastructure design/rehab, streets design/rehab, stormwater design/rehab, ROW, hydrologic/hydraulic analysis, field investigations, surveying, earthmoving, geotechnical investigations/ testing, electrical/mechanical engineering studies/design and analysis, permitting, environmental studies, NERC/FERC, Indian/Cultural affairs, land acquisition, hazard design/management, NACE/corrosion inspections, drainage and archeological reports. Travel, meetings, and/or presentations may be included in some projects

title: On-Call Professional Engineering, Architectural and Related Services
short_description: On-call multi-discipline professional services framework for municipal building and infrastructure projects.
project_scope: Qualifications-based framework for multiple professional service firms to provide as-needed services for a broad range of municipal projects. Potential assignments include general building, parks and recreation design, pedestrian and bicycle facilities, water and wastewater infrastructure design and rehabilitation, street design and rehabilitation, stormwater design and rehabilitation, ROW services, hydrologic and hydraulic analysis, field investigations, surveying, earthmoving, geotechnical investigations and testing, electrical and mechanical studies, permitting, environmental studies, land acquisition, hazard design and management, corrosion inspections, drainage, and archaeological reports. No specific building size, span, or construction volume is defined.
services: On-call professional engineering, architectural, civil, structural, electrical, instrumentation, controls, landscaping, and related consulting services on an as-needed basis; multiple contracts may be awarded.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a broad on-call framework agreement without a defined specific structure or project.
- The notice covers many disciplines, but structural engineering is only one possible component.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
- Some potentially relevant subtopics are mentioned, such as pedestrian/bicycle facilities and structural services, but no concrete bridge or special structure is identified.
- The award is for multiple firms on an as-needed basis, reducing strategic focus.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. This is an on-call professional services procurement for undefined future assignments, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee amount or budget is stated. As this is an indefinite on-call multi-award services contract with undefined task orders, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms must submit qualifications-based proposals demonstrating ability to provide a variety of professional services on an as-needed basis across engineering, architecture, and related disciplines. No specific minimum reference count or project-type qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
award_criteria: Qualifications-based proposals (RFQP); detailed weighting or evaluation criteria are not stated in the notice excerpt.
